mentions.name: Jet Lag Coach
mentions.description: An app that calculates the optimum jet lag management plan from a combination of flights, telling users the optimum times for light exposure, sleeping, and drinking coffee. It treats the schedule as a constrained optimization problem, optimizing a cost function while keeping the plan realistic, and can handle complex combinations of flights and layovers compared to similar apps.
mentions.problem: Managing jet lag from complex multi-flight itineraries; other similar apps cannot handle complex combinations of flights and layovers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the last 6-9 months, I build an app to calculate the optimum jet lag management plan from a combination of flight. It tells you the optimum times for light exposure, sleeping, taking coffee...

evidence.value: Over the last 6-9 months, I build an app to calculate the optimum jet lag management plan from a combination of flight. It tells you the optimum times for light exposure, sleeping, taking coffee...

mentions.name: Jetlag Coach
mentions.description: This app generates a personalized schedule of light exposure, sleep timing, caffeine, and melatonin to shift the user's circadian clock toward the destination time zone. Users provide their chronotype and actual itinerary (including multi-leg flights and layovers), and an optimization engine computes the schedule.
mentions.problem: Long-haul travel disrupts the circadian clock across time zones.
mentions.source_excerpt: You give it your chronotype and your actual itinerary (multi-leg and layovers included) and an optimization engine generates a personalized schedule for light, sleep timing, caffeine and melatonin to shift your circadian clock toward the destination time zone.

evidence.value: You give it your chronotype and your actual itinerary (multi-leg and layovers included) and an optimization engine generates a personalized schedule for light, sleep timing, caffeine and melatonin to shift your circadian clock toward the destination time zone.
